strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed
Hahahahaha! Fragile! So very fragile! So this is Earth... heh, pathetic.
Come quickly, Mia Alice.
Hurry, or your home planet will be torn to pieces...?
Kukuku. Fufufufufu.
Is that a mobile mech of the space pirates, Bunker...!?
It's huge! The Dinosaur Empire and Mechanical Beasts can't compare!
Tch, if it's just big, Getter-2 will run rings around it.
It'll be worth throwing, too. Even Musashi never threw one like that!
...I'm heading out! Open the hatch.
Hmm? This planet's defense force...
Hmph, they'll help kill time until they arrive.
Heh, being big isn't everything!
Joe! Don't get careless!
Show... how are we gonna beat something that big?
My Aura Power's grown stronger too. It'll be fine, Cham.
Hm... this reading...?
I see, the treasure Grand Captain Garimos spoke of... is in that robot.
Heh, I meant to lure out Mia Alice,
but what a prize has fallen into my net...
Whoa? What's wrong, Raideen!?
Akira, what's up?
I don't know, Mister.
It's just... Raideen seemed to be trying to tell me something...
Something...?
What are you doing? Is something wrong?
No, it's nothing. Let's go, everyone!
Muohh!?
Yay! ...Huh, what!?
The radar? Hm... flying objects!? Enemy reinforcements!
Whaaat, something else is coming!?
We're full up already!
So this is... Earth... my planet...
Federation fighters...? No, I've never seen that type.
There it is, Mia! Gil's robot!
Whoa, it's huge... It's fighting this planet's army... It looks strong...
Roll! You're a man, so quit your whining!
Hmm, that's...!? Heh, heh heh... Hahahahaha!
I've waited... waited so long for you, Mia Alice!
Earth... my planet. ...Let's combine!
Right!
C-Can we do it...?
We've got no choice.
Something's off...? They're not on the same side!?
Let our hearts become one...
Cross Fight!
Four fighters combined into a robot!?
A new type of enemy. Heh, Koji would love this.
Tetsuya, quit being so laid-back! Nothing's any clearer!
One after another... Which side is friendly!?
The ones chasing the big guy must be on our side...
It's a combining, transforming robot! Damn, that's awesome!
True. But it doesn't seem to transform like Getter does.
This is no time to be impressed! Koji, Ryoma!
Things are only getting more tangled up!
Easy, Sayaka, don't panic. Looks like those two are enemies.
Whose side are we supposed to be on!?
People of Earth, can you hear me!? We're not your enemy!
We came to drive out Bunker's robot!
Picking a fight with Bunker takes guts... But that doesn't matter!
All I'm after is you, Mia Alice... your life!
Not yet, I'm not beaten yet... Bloody II will settle this...!
What... there was a robot inside it?
Wh-What kind of mechanics is that?
Hmph. Cheap tricks!
That big lug was a combining robot too? Tch, if only we could combine...!
No matter how often you show up, Dangaioh won't lose! Gil Berg!
Silence... brat!
Bunker aside... what is that robot? Hm!? An energy reading...!?
What!? That bastard Gil was hiding more forces!?
No, Pai! The ID code is different... That's another enemy!
The Hyakki Empire's AI robots!
Guess we made too much noise. Looks like they found us.
What's going on? Mia's planet seems to be in trouble too...
Let's just blast 'em, Ryo!
No time to think! Let's go, everyone!
If they stand in our way, we beat them... Go, Hayato! Benkei!
Bloody, driven into a corner like this!?
Nngh, did I underestimate Earth's forces...!?
Ah! He's running away!
So he won't come back to haunt us. Let's go after him, Roll!
Lamba, Pai! ...It's all right now. Let's leave him be.
Are you sure, Mia? We can still catch him.
We managed to beat them... Now, what to do about that robot?
...What, a call on the military's private channel? Fine, put it through.
Mia... Mia, this is where we say goodbye.
It's sad, but...
...See ya.
Huh!? W-Wait a second! Why are you dropping just me off!?
Because this is your planet. The home you finally remembered.
Right. You're not a weapon, Mia... Go live in peace on your own planet.
You've got a place to come home to, after all...
Come on, Mia...
...I... I'm not getting off!
Mia!?
I'm going with all of you...!
What!? Stay with us and you'll face more of the fighting you hate...
But I... still can't remember much, and being left alone would be hard...
This mech needs all four of us, so I can't just go home by myself...
And... and besides, we're friends...
That's right! Friends who've risked our lives... so...
All right, Mia.
Hehe, honestly, I wanted to stay together!
...You sure? You won't have a home to go back to, you know?
I'll be fine!
...All right, it's settled!
You are... the Dangaioh Team, I take it?
Hm? What? How do you know about us?
Oh, I'm Mia Alice. Um, I'm an Earthling!
Thank you so much for helping us earlier.
The feeling is mutual.
I'm Hazuki, Commander of the Federation Far East Gandor Team.
Just now, we got a call from a man calling himself Dr. Tarsan.
Are you fighting under him?
Under him... Well, I guess you could say that?
What did... the Doctor say?
...The transmission cut out. It seems they've entered combat.
...What will you do? If you've nowhere to go, I'd like you to come with us.
There's no catch here, right, old man?
I won't force you.
...To be honest, we want information on Bunker.
We don't know what kind of organization we're fighting.
Mia, what do you think?
...We'll go with you.
